title: Linear: Agent sessions on mobile
how: ffmpeg streamed the video from its URL into cutscene's measure (256 px luma, every frame); nothing saved but these numbers and stills in scratch
whyTopTier: Cinema grammar on a phone UI: 24 fps, depth of field, hard cuts between close framings (diff, composer, keyboard, agent status) as the request is typed and picked up.
instrument: A perspective camera: the tracker's moves are not usable. Stills confirm at least four real framing changes (2.63, 10.29, 14.92, 17.29); the other candidates are text changing inside a shot.

byEye.zoom: close framings of an iPhone UI, tilted, shallow depth of field
byEye.cursor: none (touch UI; typing shows on the keyboard)
byEye.sound: an audio track (71 onsets); 4 of 12 cut candidates on its grid (chance 19%)

classify: Cinematic phone-UI film at 24 fps: close framings cut together. Conventions: tilted phone, depth of field, keyboard close-ups, a logo card.

diagnose.observation: Hard cuts between close framings (diff, composer, keyboard, status).
diagnose.principle: Cut-not-move: each detail is its own shot, so the phone's small text is legible at 1080p.

teaches.text: 24 fps for a filmic piece (also Notion and Notion Calendar's clips).

critique.like: Close framings make a phone's 13 px text readable without a single camera move.
critique.wish: The tilt and blur that make it filmic also hide most of each screen.
critique.wonder: Could cutscene's phone format cut between locator crops of one recording, as this cuts between close framings?
